newsitem.title: USA: PECO to restart Limerick 2 nuke next week.
newsitem.headline: PECO to restart Limerick 2 nuke next week.

text.p: PECO Energy Co said Friday it will restart the 1,055 unit 2 at its Limerick 2 nuclear generating facility next week following completion of a 25-day refueling and maintenance program.
"It will start up early next week," said a PECO spokesman.
He said the unit, in Montgomery County, Pa., may begin operation Tuesday after being taken off line Jan 30.
"There are still a lot of activities that need to be done this weekend," he added.
The adjoining Limerick unit 1, also rated at 1,055 MW, continued to operate at 100 percent power.
